release_notes.en-US: Version 2.1.2 adds signed GitHub domain rule packs, website-first false-positive reporting (no GitHub account required), optional public rule-pack refresh, and updated privacy disclosures. Still no telemetry or remote code.

GitHub optional. alarms permission for refresh schedule. Privacy policy updated. Submitted ZIP is readable unminified source. Support: https://nokaangel.dev/support?project=grandmaguard
